steps.expected: Uploaded file is retrievable through file-search flow and stays tied to the originating provider backend
steps.observed: Assistant returned `VAL_FILES_001_PROVIDER_PIN_SENTINEL: cobalt-owl-742` on initial and follow-up turns without re-upload.

steps.action: Inspect file and conversation records via authenticated API
steps.expected: Provider-pinning metadata and conversation linkage are persisted and reusable
steps.observed: `/api/files` shows one file with `metadata.nativeTool=file_search` and `metadata.openai.{endpoint,model,fileId,vectorStoreId}`; `/api/convos/a78a5aa0-21d6-4605-876f-a3f786cbda7b` includes the file in `files`; file `usage` increased from 1 to 2 after follow-up.
